contradictions: NLM's Dynamic Semantic Status Container proposal overlaps the existing state-derived live surface, AlertEdge rails, lifecycle anchors, bounded caches, and answer/reasoning projections.
The proposed Tab focus and Enter confirmation do not fit RidgeCode's existing Tab completion/selection and Enter submission contract; no key remap is accepted.

unverified_hypotheses.hypothesis: A retained lifecycle entry can mask the currently streaming Answer or Reasoning phase at the live-surface title boundary when the two projections are updated out of order.
support: CodeGraph shows live_surface_state reads activity_history before active_channel.
against: The normal token event path updates activity before appending each stream chunk.
unverified_hypotheses.experiment: Add a deterministic stale-lifecycle/current-stream regression and make the presentation projection prefer the current live channel while preserving WAIT and lifecycle fallback.

candidates.core: Make the busy live-surface state projection phase-aware: WAIT remains highest priority; a present live Answer/Reasoning/Tool block outranks stale lifecycle activity; lifecycle tags remain the fallback when no live block exists.
constraints: reuse LiveTranscript::active_channel and existing live_surface title/border
no new container rows, parser, renderer, cache, execution state, or key mapping
preserve folded tools, Answer/Reasoning separation, queue/takeover/HOLD/FOLLOW, ANSI16 and CJK width behavior
risks: an approval/error event must remain visible when no live block remains; ordering must not hide WAIT or modal-owned intervention state
a title-only change must not alter the existing channel breadcrumb or body projection
validation: stale lifecycle/current Answer regression plus existing live-surface tests
Debug/Release ConPTY with reasoning, answer, tools, waiting, resize, takeover, and double Ctrl-C

recommendation: Reject generic DSSC as local overlap. Accept only the narrow state-precedence correction at the existing live-surface boundary, then validate the same title/border projection across current stream, WAIT, lifecycle-only, narrow, and resized frames.

next_step.value: Complete the stale-lifecycle/current-live-channel regression and run the bounded TUI/PTY quality gates.
